cameraPreview.unavailable: Camera isn't available ({{reason}}). The exam goes on, and this is recorded.

attemptSession.couldNotSave: Couldn't save your answers. Check your connection and try again.

authPanel.leftWindowSubmitted: You left the exam window, so the attempt was submitted automatically and the exam ended.
authPanel.timeoutSubmitted: Time ran out, your answers were submitted automatically.

preExam.warningCopy: Once you start, the window goes full screen and locks: you won't be able to close it, minimize it, or switch to another app. Leaving the window, even briefly, is recorded as a possible cheating attempt along with a screenshot. Don't start until you're ready to stay in the exam the whole time.
preExam.rechecksAutomatically: This checks again by itself every few seconds.

problems.extraScreens: {{count}} screens are connected. A second screen could show answers or a lookup outside the exam - disconnect all but one.
problems.forbiddenApp: {{app}} is running, which {{reason}}. Close it before starting.
problems.otherWindows: Other windows are open: {{windows}}. Anything else open could be used to look something up or message someone during the exam - close them before starting.
problems.updating: An update is downloading in the background. Wait a moment for it to finish, then try again.

appReasons.remoteControl: lets someone else see and control your screen remotely
appReasons.screenShare: can share your screen with someone else
appReasons.other: could be used to get help during the exam

preExam.checkingScreen: Checking your screen… If your computer asks whether to allow screenshots, allow it.
preExam.cameraUnavailableDetail: {{reason}}. The exam can go on without it, and this is recorded.
preExam.typeIdAndPhoto: Type your ID number, then hold your ID card next to your face and take the photo.
preExam.pictureNotReady: The camera picture isn't ready yet, try again in a moment.
preExam.idMismatchDetail: Type the ID number assigned to your own account.
preExam.noFaceTitle: No face found in the photo
preExam.noFaceDetail: Make sure your face is clearly visible to the camera and try again.
preExam.mismatchDetail: The photo didn't match your reference photo. Check the lighting and try again.
preExam.takePhotoAndStart: Take the photo and start the exam
preExam.clockStarts: The exam clock starts when you press the button.
